creator: Alexander Terp
description: A handoff hands every live pane to a new daemon binary. If that binary cannot start (a bad build, a missing library, macOS's first-run scan outlasting the handoff's patience), the handoff fails late. The test suite already launches a copied daemon once before handing over to it (411ac73) for exactly this reason. The app, or muster-daemon replace itself, could run the successor with --version first and refuse the handoff with a clear reason if it does not answer.
title: Launch a successor daemon once before handing panes to it
